title: Portable public land asset sales migration features

features.title: Accessible public asset catalogue
features.outcome: Map and list discovery with stable URLs, status, dates, documents, subscriptions and machine-readable records.

features.title: Australian GIS and open-data adapters
features.outcome: Connect authorised Landgate/SLIP, NationalMap, data.gov.au, OGC and ArcGIS REST sources without baking one provider into the core model.

features.title: Temporal map and asset history
features.outcome: Explore dated imagery, geometry, status and transaction events without overwriting current state.

features.title: Portable data and exit model
features.outcome: Canonical schema, stable IDs, OpenAPI and complete GeoJSON/CSV/JSON exports keep presentation platforms replaceable.

features.title: Legacy automation migration
features.outcome: Inventory Office VBA separately from IIS/.NET code and route each automation to Office Scripts, Power Automate, a service, retirement or manual rewrite.

features.title: TLS and public edge baseline
features.outcome: Diagnose certificates, trust, protocols, ciphers, proxies, IIS and application behaviour before bounded remediation.

features.title: Information protection and DLP
features.outcome: Separate public and restricted fields and simulate DLP before staged enforcement.

features.title: Safe document publication
features.outcome: Scan, sanitise, classify and attribute downloadable documents while preserving records metadata and hashes.

features.title: Status workflow and notifications
features.outcome: Publish approved asset milestones and notify subscribers without exposing internal workflow detail.

features.title: Migration reconciliation and rollback
features.outcome: Reconcile records, documents, geometry, permissions, status and history before cutover, with a tested return path.
